SimpleMindMap browser core bundle
Package: simple-mind-map 0.14.0-fix.3
Source: https://github.com/wanglin2/mind-map
License: MIT

The bundled core was built from the package's framework-independent JavaScript
entry point. Optional plugins were excluded. The page loads this bundle locally.
The complete SimpleMindMap license is in SIMPLE-MIND-MAP-LICENSE.txt.

Runtime dependencies included in the bundle:

@svgdotjs/svg.js 3.2.0, MIT
License: SVG-JS-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/svgdotjs/svg.js

deepmerge 1.5.2, MIT
License: DEEPMERGE-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/TehShrike/deepmerge

eventemitter3 4.0.7, MIT
License: EVENTEMITTER3-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/primus/eventemitter3

uuid 9.0.1, MIT
License: UUID-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/uuidjs/uuid
